author: RAFAEL MELO REIS
hypothesis: At the RLL null Omega_s0=0, z_t and w_t are non-identifiable and materially contribute to G6 MCMC mixing failure.
invariants: same G4/G5 data, covariance, selection and nuisance route in both arms
same seeds, walkers, steps, burn and Rhat threshold in both arms
no threshold relaxation after observing results
fixed-shape arm is diagnostic only and cannot become a physical model claim
negative or inconclusive outcomes are preserved

mcmc.initialization: independent Gaussian clouds around the G4 best fit with sigma=0.02 of each sampled prior width; clipped strictly inside bounds

fixed_shape_diagnostic_arm.fixed_value_authority: RLL canonical defaults in tools/run_g4_background_tournament.py MODEL_SPEC[RLL].canonical
fixed_shape_diagnostic_arm.interpretation: Diagnostic removal of null-only shape freedom; not an alternative physical-model claim.

required_outputs: exact G4 and G5 SHA-256 bindings
Omega_s0 posterior quantiles in both arms
falsifiers: fixed-shape diagnostic fails to improve convergence while free-shape remains nonconverged
G4/G5 hash or likelihood route differs between arms
fixed z_t/w_t values are selected after inspecting this run
boundary: H52 diagnostic support reduces uncertainty about a sampler pathology; it does not validate RLL, resolve nested-seed stability, close perturbations, or justify CLASS/CAMB RLL implementation.
